'''2002 Houston Mini-Open''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament in Houston, Texas in July 2002. [[Justin Warren]] won with a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list (''Raging Bull (Hoostino's Hunt Down Hammer)'').<ref name="dt-24516">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24516 Raging Bull (Hoostino's Hunt Down Hammer)], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 20 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24516/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24516/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009044330/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24516/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' July 2002
* '''Site:''' Houston, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
